title: BOX WITH LARGE QUANTITY OF TRI...
reason: Box of mixed trinkets includes a Launceston coat of arms dish with thylacines (local collector interest) plus Japanese hand-painted and German style pieces, otherwise modest items.
findings: Large cardboard box packed with mixed china and figurines. Includes a scalloped gilt-edged dish printed with a coat of arms supported by two striped thylacines (they appear to wear collars) and a caption that looks like LAUNCESTON TASMANIA (partly legible); this may be the City of Launceston arms (granted 1957 per a heraldry site) rather than the state arms, so probably a mid 20th century local souvenir, maker not seen. Also: Japanese style hand-painted plates (geisha scene plates with gilt edges, a landscape plate), a Japanese eggshell style cup with gilt landscape, a gilt-handled heart-shaped dish with pink and yellow roses (Nippon or Noritake style, unmarked in the photo), lace-trimmed German style porcelain figures (a crinoline lady, a carriage with horses and two figures), carved wooden salad servers, a green jade-look resin temple lion, an Imari style plate, a mug captioned American Homestead Winter, Currier & Ives, a veteran car transfer cup, floral gilt-rimmed teacups, and brass and wood trinket boxes. A small white vase has an illegible black printed mark on its base. No other maker's marks legible.
condition: Bases not shown and items are piled on each other. The Launceston dish has light wear to the printed arms and some gilt rim wear. No breaks seen in the photos, but lace figures are fragile.
rescore_note: Big box of mostly mid 20th century Japanese and German-style ornamental china and cups; the Launceston thylacine arms dish adds local interest and the rose heart dish may be Nippon, but bases are unseen and most pieces are low value, so $30 to 80 band. (no web price check)
